summary: The article argues that the gig economy and online freelance marketplaces are revitalizing small-town America by removing geographic limits on work, diversifying local economies, and improving resilience. It cites examples such as a Greenfield, Indiana designer, a Brooksville, Maine initiative, and a Bridgton, Colorado college program. It also covers technology, internet access, and education as enablers, and concludes the trend is lasting.
one_line: The gig economy and freelance marketplaces are helping small American towns diversify, stabilize their economies, and connect residents to global work.
key_facts: Freelance platforms such as Upwork, Freelancer, and Fiverr have grown from niche sites into household names.
Linda Martin, a small business owner in Greenfield, Indiana, left an office job requiring an hour's drive each way and became a full-time freelance graphic designer about two years earlier.
Steven Parker, an economist at the University of Wisconsin, says freelancing opens opportunity for people where traditional jobs are hard to find.
A community initiative launched on October 5, 2023 in Brooksville, Maine aims to educate residents about gig economy opportunities.
Mayor Emily Johnson of Brooksville says the town has already seen a number of success stories from people taking control of their economic future.
A study released on September 15, 2023 by the Center for Economic Development found towns with a higher percentage of gig workers were more economically stable.
The study found gig-heavy towns had less volatility during downturns and recovered more quickly.
The local community college in Bridgton, Colorado launched a 'Freelancer's Toolkit' program on September 21, 2023.
Program director Abigail Hart says the Freelancer's Toolkit teaches 'a mindset,' not just skills, helping students become self-sufficient, resilient workers.
The article says reliable internet service is perhaps the most significant technological effect, letting small-town residents compete globally.
Cloud computing, online collaboration, payment processing, and AI matching algorithms support the freelance workforce.
Local businesses like coffee shops and co-working spaces benefit as freelancers seek productive environments.
